One day, while they were jogging, a big, mean cat came out of the bushes. The cat wanted to take Tim away from Spot. Spot did not like this at all. The cat and Spot started to fight.
Spot barked and barked, and the cat hissed and hissed. They fought for a minute, but then Tim yelled "Stop!" The cat ran away, and Spot was happy. Tim hugged Spot and they went back to jogging. They knew they would always be loyal friends.

As they were playing, a big frog jumped out of the pond. The frog said, "Please do not disturb my home." Tim and his friends looked at the frog and listened with their ears. They did not want to make the frog sad.
Tim said, "We will not disturb your home, Mr. Frog. We will play somewhere else." Tim and his friends moved away from the pond. The frog was very happy, and so were Tim and his friends. The moral of the story is to be kind and listen to others.
